name: Which products account for the top 90% of revenue?
python_code:
# Calculate revenue per product (StockCode)
df['Revenue'] = df['Quantity'] * df['Price']

# Group by product (StockCode) and sum revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('StockCode')['Revenue'].sum().reset_index()

# Sort by revenue descending
product_revenue = product_revenue.sort_values('Revenue', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = product_revenue['Revenue'].sum()

# Calculate cumulative revenue percentage
product_revenue['CumulativeRevenuePct'] = product_revenue['Revenue'].cumsum() / total_revenue

# Filter products that account for top 90% of revenue
result = product_revenue[product_revenue['CumulativeRevenuePct'] <= 0.90].copy()
